https://web.archive.org/web/20260101232732/https://www.marathoncounty.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/10176/638266542080312273 (Wayback capture 2026-01-01 of the county's 'PROPOSED 2025 FACILITY AND PROGRAM FEES AND 2026 FACILITY/SHELTER/CAMPGROUND FEES', PDF dated 2024-10-09; marathoncounty.gov itself answers Akamai 403): 'Dells of the Eau Claire Park (28 Sites)': 'Electric Site (23 sites)' $25 (2024) / $27 (2025) / $28 (2026) a night; 'Non-Electricity Site (5 sites)' $20 / $22 / $23; camping 'Reservation Fee' $10 (2025-26); 'Current Sales Tax 5.50%'.

https://web.archive.org/web/20250311034514/https://www.marathoncounty.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/13497/638584683923270000 (Wayback capture 2025-03-11 of the county's 'Dells of Eau Claire Campground' map dated 01/06/2021; layout only): sites 1-28 with 26 an 'Administrative Site'; 50 A sites 1, 3, 4, 6, 19, 21-25, 27, 28; 30 A sites 10-18, 20; non-electric 2, 5, 7, 8, 9; 'NR Non-Reservable Campsite' 2, 5, 7, 9; self-registration station, well, firewood, vault restrooms, dumpster. https://web.archive.org/web/20260527134504/https://www.marathoncounty.gov/Home/Components/FacilityDirectory/FacilityDirectory/38/60 (Wayback capture 2026-05-27 of the county's park page): 'Campground: 28 sites, 16 w/electricity, self-registration for numbered sites, gravel camp areas, vault toilet, wood shed, manager contact cottage, 1 picnic table per campsite, water pump, recycling station, dumpster, dump station, potable water.'
Google Maps (as read by the earlier verifier p3-485): 4.8 over 523, 715-261-1550.

Esri imagery (tools/sat.py, 2026-11-20) around 45.0055,-89.3352: the loop sits under continuous canopy between County Y and a north-south park lane; the Eau Claire River and the dam pond lie ~150 m and more south and east through woods.

summary: marathoncounty.gov still Akamai 403; read the county's new reservation site live via headless (prices, 60-ft sites, 50/30 A pedestals, May 1-Sep 30, 2-night online minimum) plus Wayback captures of the county fee schedule (2026 $28 electric / $23 non-electric, $10 reservation fee, 5.5% tax), the 2021 campground map (27 sites, 22 electric, NR 2/5/7/9) and the 2026 park page (dump station). Waterfront riverview -> not waterfront. Pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverview -> not waterfront (sweep-derived value, no --AWH). The 2021 county park map and Esri put the camping loop just east of County Hwy Y under continuous canopy; the nearest water (the Eau Claire River below the dam, the dam pond to the east) is ~150-300 m away through woods - no site sees it.

PIN: stored 45.0074,-89.3358 is ~120 m north of the loop (~45.0063,-89.3352 from the county park map scaled to the dam bridge) - under 250 m, no move. (A working note earlier in this batch guessed 300 m west; the county map shows that is the west side of County Y, the group campsite and shelters - disregard.)

SITES: stored count 28 -> 27 (site 26 is administrative). Electric sites: the map shows 22 (12 at 50 A, 10 at 30 A); the fee schedule says 23 electric + 5 non-electric; the 2026 county page still says '16 w/electricity'. Stored max_rig_ft 60 now sourced ('Site is 60 feet in length').

MINIMUM STAY: online bookings carry 'Min: 2 nights' (no weekend/holiday distinction in the engine's settings); the four non-reservable self-registration sites appear to take single nights. Not a 3+ night minimum - no drop.

FEES: the engine's per-night quotes ($32.23 electric, $27.49 non-electric) exceed the 2026 schedule ($28/$23) plus 5.5% tax - probably processing/platform fees on top or a 2027 rate; the schedule's 2027 column is 'TBD'.

BOOKING: Rec1 catalog (secure.rec1.com) retired 2026-05-28 ('Visit our new site, this one is no longer operational. www.parks.marathoncounty.gov'); platform operator with the new county reservation URL.

WEBSITE: https://www.marathoncounty.gov/Home/Components/FacilityDirectory/FacilityDirectory/38/60 refuses bots (Akamai 403) but is live per a 2026-05-27 capture - keep it; the booking URL goes in booking.url.
